artworks.title: Saturn Devouring His Son
artworks.description: Goya's Black Painting — Cronus/Saturn devouring a child, the Titan's reign remembered as appetite that swallows the next generation.

artworks.title: Saturn Devouring His Son
artworks.description: Rubens' Saturn — the same cannibal kingship in Baroque flesh, Hesiod's swallower of the Olympians-to-be.

artworks.title: The Mutilation of Uranus by Saturn
artworks.description: Vasari's Palazzo Vecchio fresco — Saturn castrating Uranus, the coup that begins Cronus' golden and terrible reign.

popCulture.title: Golden Age
popCulture.description: Cronus' reign became Hesiod's Golden Age — the lost paradise of easy harvests that later ages could only remember.

popCulture.title: Cronus
popCulture.description: The Titan who ruled before Zeus — sickle, swallowed children, and the Golden Age later ages could only name.
